description:
docs/README.md and docs/index.md duplicate each other (quick links, structure diagram, getting-started list) and must be kept in sync by hand; both omit docs/examples/ and several existing reference docs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: One authoritative landing page remains; any second file is a pointer to it
- [hard] REQ-02: The landing page lists docs/examples/ and every existing reference doc
- [hard] REQ-03: All landing-page links resolve
title: Consolidate the docs landing pages
